title: Hinomori Shizuku — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Goodness... You've been smiling all day, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm just so happy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My fans put so much thought into their recipes and gave me all those wonderful messages...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This has been such a wonderful birthday.
Hey! Shizuku, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello! Mizuki, Tsukasa and even Kamishiro. You're all here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you all on your way home? What a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
It's not a coincidence at all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's your birthday today, right? I know you've been busy, but we wanted to give our wishes in person. We got in contact with Airi and waited here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! All so that we could ambush you with a surprise!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that you've said ambush, I'm getting a little apprehensive...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, one's birthday is truly a special kind of day. I felt that these sorts of things are better done in person when possible.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Just for me?
Thank you so much. That makes me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! It's a little early for that.
Akiyama, please do the honors!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Roger dodger♪
Here you are, Shizuku. This is our gift to you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh my. You've gotten me a gift as well?
Is this... A little bird doll?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The wings feel so nice and soft. I can just wrap it up with my two hands—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <HAPPY BIRTHDAAAAAAY!!!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: D-Did that voice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Come from this little bird?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Shizuku♪
Let's hang out and do some sewing again sometime!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
This time it's Mizuki's voice!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold on... Could there be a button somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's correct.
The doll will play different voice messages when you press its beak.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I bought this small bird after seeing it at a store since I thought it'd make the perfect birthday gift!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But then I wanted to add to it and make it better, so I asked Rui and the others for help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
By the way, apparently it'll play the voices at random!
I've recorded a few messages on there myself. Please do give them a listen!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Besides us, we also got An, Ena and Ena's Li'l Bro to record something. I even got Mafuyu in it too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no idea. Everyone's voices are in here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for the wonderful gift! I'll listen carefully to everyone's messages.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Nice to meet you, one-of-a-kind special little bird.
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright, I think I'll place this chatty little bird... On top of this shelf.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (To be able to hear everyone's voices at any time just by pressing its beak... That's so sweet.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So many people wished me a happy birthday today.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I was able to say thank you to my fans during today's stream, too...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Being able to directly express my feelings to everyone like this makes me so happy.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm going to treasure these moments going forward as well.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Speaking of expressing gratitude...
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. So that's why you've come to visit us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was so surprised! We were just preparing for your birthday party when you suddenly came over!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I freaked out! For a second I thought maybe we got the dates wrong.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hahaha... I wondered what happened when Rin came in running like the wind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry for scaring all of you.
But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really wanted to express my gratitude to all of you in person today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So many people wished me a happy birthday today, which made me realize something all over again. I'm able to be an idol thanks to everyone supporting me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And of course, you are some of those people.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Whenever I'm lost or struggling, I'm able to move forward because you're there to give me the push I need.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'd like to say...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much for always supporting me, and looking out for me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And... I look forward to more memories with you too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It makes us happy to hear you say that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It really does. Of course, it's really because of your own efforts that you're able to continue being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm happy to hear that we could be a source of strength for you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. After hearing what Shizuku said, I just feel like singing now♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I totally get how you feel!
It makes me want to express my feelings to you too, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well then, shall we do a special impromptu show for Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A special show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, that's a wonderful idea!
I'd love to do a special show♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! It's settled! To the stage we go!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh dear, Rin got a head start.
Luka, we should head over to the stage too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's.
se_run_women_002_1
se_run_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... There they go.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If it's a special show to express our feelings to Shizuku, then we'll have to join in, won't we?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We'd like you to watch our show from the front row, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're going to show you how we feel by singing, so I hope you look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'll be more than happy to watch from here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I came here to express my gratitude, and yet, I ended up getting another gift.
But...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't wait to watch your special show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku!
I'm glad that I was able to wish you a happy birthday in person. Were you able to listen to all of my messages?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
He recorded all of them with a lot of heart as well as a loud voice.
Happy birthday, Hinomori. Don't hesitate to let me know if the little bird doll ever needs fixing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Once again, happy birthday, Shizuku!
I'm glad you liked our gift♪
Enjoy listening to everyone's messages as many times as you want!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a little embarrassing that my voice will be there for the foreseeable future... But it is for your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, but I also have a gift for you, so let's meet up sometime and have our own celebration!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was a little surprised when Mizuki suddenly asked me to send a voice message. Though, I'm glad that you liked it, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku!
I'm sad I'm not able to tell you in person, but I put a lot of thought into my message, so I hope you get to listen to it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hinomori.
If you're ever up for it, I hope you'll hang out with Ena again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I made sure to take lots of photos of the snow rabbit cake beforehand. That way you'll be able to see it again after you've had it. I'll make sure to pass the photos to Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We did a lot of trial and error to come up with the cake recipe. I hope it turned out to your liking...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho was actually the one who suggested we decorate the cake like a snow rabbit. She said she was sure that you would really like it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the way, Shiho was super strict on the quality of the rabbit's body and face! She was very adamant on it being perfect before we gave it to you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, you guys didn't have to tell her all that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, seemed like she really liked it, anyway, and that's all that matters. Happy birthday, Shizuku. Let's both keep doing our best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku!
Getting to see you happily eat your favorite food made me happy too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Same here. With so many of our fans wishing you a happy birthday, it looked like you were really enjoying yourself. I'm so glad we did that segment. Once again, happy birthday, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I should've known that you'd say something like wanting to eat your favorite food with your favorite people for your birthday. You could ask for more, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll make the dishes from the recipes we couldn't include in our stream for you sometime, so look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for celebrating my birthday with me, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Having so many people wish me a happy birthday like this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Has, once again, made me realize that it's thanks to everyone who has been watching over me thus far that I'm able to stand on the stage like I am right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your support gives me strength.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't express in words just how grateful I am.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I'll be sure to express these feelings through our activities as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope that you continue to watch over me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll be counting on your support!
